The '''M2-AUX Foreman''' was a type of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] used by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At least two Foremans were employed at [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]], a genetic research facility.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M2-AUX Foreman appears as a NPC in the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access. It appears as a friendly character at the start of the Flashpoint, at the surface docks of the facility, but Game Update 3.0: Shadow of Revan Early Access added a Hard Mode version of the Flashpoint that includes another, hostile M2-AUX Foreman within the facility as a bonus boss.<ref name="TOR" />
